highlights: Voxel Remesh 3-4x faster, always in the background so the app never freezes
High-DPI Windows laptops (150-200% scaling): the window opens inside the screen
The right tray opens in every look on 1280 px screens; QuickMenu gets square thumbnails
New update channel: Preferences > Updates picks Stable or Preview (betas)
Fast Big Brushes (Experimental): a new experimental path for big brushes on dense meshes; turn it on in Preferences > Performance and tell us how it feels.
Sixty new brushes in six built-in packs, and A-Z sorting everywhere
A Masking panel: mask by cavity, peaks, colour, facing and more
Quick tour for experienced sculptors (Help > Quick tour): ten slides with Show me, the last one about memberships
Experimental, off by default: Live Move, Background Preview and Fast Upload (Preferences > Performance)
